name: Jeezer
title: Son of Gilead and patriarch of the Jeezerite clan
summary: Jeezer (also known as Jezer or Abiezer in some translations) was a son of Gilead, grandson of Machir, and great-grandson of Manasseh. He was the patriarch of the Jeezerite clan, one of the important families in the tribe of Manasseh who received land in the Promised Land.

keyEvents.title: Registered as a son of Gilead
keyEvents.description: Iezer is listed as one of the sons of Gilead, son of Makir, son of Manasseh. He became the ancestor of the clan of the Iezrites.

keyEvents.title: Land allocation to the descendants of Manasseh
keyEvents.description: Iezer and his clan received an inheritance as part of the tribe of Manasseh when the land was distributed among the tribes of Israel.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of Manasseh
keyEvents.description: Iezer is recorded in the tribal genealogy of Manasseh as one of the important clan leaders in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: The census on the plains of Moab
keyEvents.description: During the census conducted by Moses and Eleazar on the plains of Moab, the Iezrites were counted as a distinct clan within the tribe of Manasseh.
